description: Decision rules for mapping campaign state to loop system. Rules are evaluated in priority order; first matching condition wins.

invariants.mutual_exclusion: At most ONE of {combat,social,challenge,rest,travel,exploration}.active is true at any time. On loop entry, set that loop's flag true and clear all others. Priority ordering is a safety net, never the primary router.
invariants.active_loop_sync: campaign_state.active_loop.loop MUST equal the single active flag (or 'exploration' when none of the encounter flags are set). See campaign-loop-contract.json dispatch_invariants.
invariants.two_router_relationship: This contract is the ENTRY router (by state flag, on load/resume: 'which loop resumes?'). scene/contracts/scene-dispatch-contract.json is the WITHIN-SCENE router (by encounter_type: 'which sub-loop fires?'). merchant and item-use have no top-level flag; they are reached only via the scene encounter_type path, then tracked with active_loop while running.
invariants.no_stub_dispatch: Only dispatch a loop whose skill directory exists under .claude/skills/<loop>/. Never route to a missing handler.
